# This folder must contain the built plugin

Obsidian loads exactly three files from here:

- `main.js`
- `manifest.json`
- `styles.css`

They are not committed because `main.js` is generated by the build. From the
repository root:

```bash
npm install && npm run build
cp main.js manifest.json styles.css \
   examples/vault/.obsidian/plugins/modelica-studio/
```

Then open `examples/vault/` as a vault and enable the plugin.
